summary: Phase-3 focused testing of Multi-image Product Gallery feature (create + edit + reorder + remove + storefront). Backend: 7/8 new gallery tests PASSED in /app/backend/tests/test_gallery.py; PATCH /api/admin/products/{id} correctly persists arbitrary images arrays (append, remove, reorder, single-image fallback) and honors client-supplied hover_image. Frontend: admin login -> Products tab -> Add Product -> paste 3 image URLs -> Save creates a product with Photos = '3 img'. Edit modal pre-loads existing thumbnails (admin-gallery-thumb-0..2), remove works, then adding a new URL + Save persists to '3 img'. Deleting via row trash icon works. Storefront PDP /products/aj4-retro-white-oreo renders 4 pdp-thumbnail-{i} and clicking pdp-thumbnail-1 swaps pdp-main-image src. Phase-2 regression: 13/13 still PASS. Phase-1 regression suite (backend_test.py) currently shows 9 pre-existing failures caused by shared requests.Session cookie pollution between the admin/customer login fixtures — NOT related to gallery feature.

critical.issue: Server overrides client-supplied hover_image on create: `body['hover_image'] = body['images'][-1]` unconditionally sets it to the LAST image in the array, but the product spec + frontend expectation is `hover_image = images[1] || images[0]` (the SECOND image, used for hover-swap on storefront cards). With a 3-image gallery [A,B,C] the frontend POSTs hover_image=B but backend saves C. PATCH does not have this bug (honors the client value), so editing masks the issue. Fix: on POST use `body['hover_image'] = body['images'][1] if len(body['images'])>1 else body['images'][0]` (or simply don't override when hover_image is already supplied by the client).

minor.issue: PATCH blindly `$set`s any keys the client sends; no allow-list. A malicious admin/staff could inject arbitrary fields (e.g. `avg_rating`, `sort_order`, or unknown attrs) into the product doc. Consider a Pydantic model with explicit fields.
No unique-slug validation; two products can be created with identical slugs (breaks /products/{slug} lookups).

ui_bugs.issue: Remove button is `opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100`; on touch devices / when playwright doesn't hover, the button is invisible & unclickable without force. Consider making it always-visible on small screens or on focus.

action_items: Fix POST /api/admin/products hover_image logic — use images[1]||images[0] (or trust client-supplied value) instead of images[-1]. This is the only functional bug found in the gallery feature.

Investigate/repair Phase-1 regression suite fixture hygiene: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py uses a session-scoped `s` requests.Session shared between admin_token & customer_token fixtures — the second login overwrites the httpOnly auth cookie and later 'no-auth' & 'authenticated' assertions get the wrong identity, causing 9 unrelated failures. Fix by using fresh sessions per fixture or clearing cookies between logins. Not blocking gallery feature.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /admin/products: hover_image derivation is inconsistent with PATCH and with frontend contract — canonical location for this logic should be a helper (e.g., derive_hover(images)) used by both handlers.
MultiImageInput uses `key={`${im}-${i}`}` — if the same URL is added twice React will warn/re-mount incorrectly; consider generating a stable UUID per gallery entry.
Drag-and-drop uses a bare `dragIdx` ref with no visual drop-indicator or keyboard fallback — accessibility miss; consider react-dnd or arrow-key reordering.
MultiImageInput.addFiles uploads files sequentially in a for-loop (`await` per file); parallelize with Promise.all for faster bulk uploads.
ProductForm resets `saving` state after `onSaved()` closes the modal — if onSaved throws or unmounts synchronously the `setSaving(false)` on an unmounted component will log a warning.
server.py is still ~1200 lines (was flagged in iter-2); admin product routes would fit cleanly in a products.py router.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of gallery flows (create + edit + remove + storefront) exercised

seed_data_creation: None persisted — TEST Gallery Product + TEST FE Gallery products were created and then deleted at end of each test. AJ-4 seeded gallery untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Gallery tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_gallery.py — run with `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest backend/tests/test_gallery.py -n 0 -v`. The only failing test is TestCreateWithGallery::test_create_product_with_multiple_images which asserts hover_image==images[1] but backend currently saves images[-1]; after E1 fixes the POST handler, this test will pass. PATCH is already correct. The 9 phase-1 (backend_test.py) failures are session-cookie pollution between admin/customer login fixtures — pre-existing, not caused by this change.
rca of the issue: Backend server.py lines 824-825: `if body.get('images'): body['hover_image'] = body['images'][-1]` unconditionally overrides the hover_image supplied by the ProductForm (which sends `images[1] || images[0]`). Impact: storefront ProductCard hover-swap displays the LAST gallery image instead of the intended SECOND image whenever an admin creates a product with 3+ photos. Reproduction: POST /api/admin/products with images=[A,B,C], hover_image=B -> stored hover_image=C. Fix in place should be `body['hover_image'] = body['images'][1] if len(body['images']) > 1 else body['images'][0]` OR only default when the client did not supply hover_image.
